hmlr_guards.general_boundary_rule: great majority of registered titles show general boundaries
hmlr_guards.rule: no standard tolerance measurement or ratio may be attributed between mapped general title-plan boundary and legal boundary
hmlr_guards.title_plan_role: graphic representation of general extent; read with register
hmlr_guards.determined_boundary_rule: exact-line treatment is a separate determined-boundary process
hmlr_guards.pg10_rule: illustrative index-map plans do not define individual title extent; title plan warns general position not exact line and scaled measurements may differ on ground
hmlr_guards.os_rule: Ordnance Survey topographic mapping does not itself define legal property boundaries

ea_accuracy_guards.rule: absolute and relative LiDAR accuracy specifications are dataset/survey quality semantics, not parcel-specific confidence intervals
ea_accuracy_guards.ground_truth_rule: ground truth control evidence is not parcel elevation output

target_effect.native_hmlr_polygon_use: geometry routing and raster masking only
